title: Senior Security Engineer, Digital Forensics
descriptionHtml:
There's no such thing as a "safe system" - only safer systems. Our Security team works to create and maintain the safest operating environment for Google's users and developers. As a Security Engineer, you help protect network boundaries, keep computer systems and network devices hardened against attacks and provide security services to protect highly sensitive data like passwords and customer information. Security Engineers work directly with network equipment and actively monitor our systems for attacks and intrusions. You also work with software engineers to proactively identify and fix security flaws and vulnerabilities.

You use your industry experience to own and drive the resolution of complex security incidents, policy questions and technical security issues.

Google is creating next-generation technologies that will revolutionize how billions of people connect and interact with each other and information. Security and Privacy are critical components to these new solutions. If you are passionate about information security, privacy and technology, and want to help keep the world safe, then joining our Security Response team might be for you! Google’s “Detection and Response” team finds and responds to threats 24/7 across 3 regions.

In Security Response, you will be a member of our global on-call response team and use your broad security experience and Digital Forensic and Incident Response (DFIR)-specific domain knowledge to investigate and respond to escalations from across Alphabet. As a part of the Security Response team member, you will train and grow in broad forensic investigation and crisis management skills, but specialize in one or the other as their career grows.
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $174000 - $252000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Perform investigations on a wide variety of security and privacy events from various sources to determine whether they pose a threat to Google.
  • Respond to security and privacy incidents, write incident reports, and participate in post-mortems.
  • Participate in internal training to make sure forensic best practices are followed.
  • Work with teams from around Google to discover new investigative and forensics capabilities.
  • Develop internal and Open Source tools used to respond to incidents (e.g., digital forensic toolkits) to support Google’s unique environment.

Minimum qualifications:

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

title: Staff ATE Test Engineer
descriptionHtml:

You will own the end-to-end silicon test life-cycle, establishing methodologies that close the loop between field performance, design, and testing for future generations of chips. You will lead cross-functional initiatives to integrate advanced SoC technologies into devices and architect robust ATE manufacturing tests that ensure optimal performance and yield. As a Staff Engineer, you will set the technical direction for test coverage and quality standards across the organization.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. US: $192000 - $278000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Define and direct broad strategies for SoC product NPI, bring-up, verification, characterization, and qualification, resolving complex issues across bench testing, test-coverage optimization, and system-to-ATE correlation.
  • Act as a domain expert in ATE testing, leveraging deep industry experience to establish technical standards, architect scalable test solutions, and mentor engineering teams to drive systemic quality improvements.
  • Influence and partner strategically with design, DFT, and quality teams to shape next-generation chip architectures, ensuring proactive "design-for-testability" and establishing industry-leading best practices for post-silicon testing.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred qualifications:

title: Senior Software Engineer, Site Reliability Engineering, Traffic Control
descriptionHtml:

SRE ensures that Google Cloud's services—both our internally critical and our externally-visible systems—have reliability, uptime appropriate to customer's needs and a fast rate of improvement. Additionally SRE’s will keep an ever-watchful eye on our systems capacity and performance.

Much of our software development focuses on optimizing existing systems, building infrastructure and eliminating work through automation. On the SRE team, you’ll have the opportunity to manage the complex challenges of scale which are unique to Google Cloud, while using your expertise in coding, algorithms, complexity analysis and large-scale system design. SRE's culture of intellectual curiosity, problem solving and openness is key to its success. Our organization brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big and take risks in a blame-free environment. We promote self-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to create an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn and grow.Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Responsibilities

Minimum qualifications:

  • 3 years of experience in designing, analyzing, and troubleshooting large-scale distributed systems.
  • 2 years of experience leading projects and providing technical leadership.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Computer Science or Engineering.

title: Software Engineer II, Content Safety
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. title: Senior Product Manager, Images Feed Quality, Google Search
descriptionHtml:
Join us to build the future of the Google Images experience. Building on the foundation of Google Images, one of the world's largest visual discovery surfaces, we are on a mission to transform how billions of people explore, evaluate, and act on visual information. We are evolving Google Images from a transactional, query-based retrieval grid into a fluid, personalized, and AI-powered visual guide.

At the heart of this transformation is building the next-generation inspiration feed. More than just answering queries, we are reimagining how users around the world browse, discover trends, and explore their passions across fashion, home, beauty, travel, and culture. This is a strategic priority for Google Search, offering a rare opportunity to reimagine a core consumer product for the next generation of visual-first users.

As the Product Manager for Images Feed Quality, you will own the core intelligence engine behind the newly launched Images Feed. Being at the intersection of consumer product intuition and frontier AI research, you will define how we model human taste, retrieve and rank multimodal content, and dynamically tune the feed in real time. You will partner closely with your cross-functional team and Google DeepMind (GDM) to bring foundation models and generative retrieval to users at global scale, creating a feed that feels deeply personal, aesthetically inspiring, and effortlessly controllable. This is a technical role requiring deep expertise across the AI stack, bringing together world knowledge with personal context to deliver a highly inspiring user experience.

In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.

title: Principal Engineer, Safeguards
descriptionHtml:
Within the Cloud AI organization, we focus on building highly differentiated, highly scalable, and easy-to-use products and services that enable our customers to transform their business with AI. Products such as Vertex AI and Gemini Enterprise comprise a portfolio that spans the needs of Developers, Data Scientists, Operation specialists in a broad range of industries. We not only provide customers with state-of-the-art models, such as Gemini, but also full Agent platforms and applications with strong security and governance.

The Principal Engineer, Cloud AI Safeguards is a senior individual contributor and the technical authority for safety and security across the Cloud AI product portfolio, with a primary focus on agentic safety. Reporting to the Senior Director of Cloud AI Safeguards Engineering, this role sets technical direction without managing people: defining architecture, raising the engineering bar, and personally designing and building defenses that meaningfully reduce risk as model capabilities, product surfaces, and adversaries evolve. Agentic systems make the safety problem substantially harder — autonomous tool use, long-horizon planning, and untrusted inputs expand the attack surface — and this role exists to get ahead of that complexity rather than react to it.

The ideal applicant looks deeply into hard problems, approaches them with curiosity and objectivity, works across teams and individuals to recommend solutions, and makes complexity legible by explaining it clearly and designing it away.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Own the technical vision and reference architecture for safeguarding agentic systems across tool use, planning, memory, and multi-agent interactions, etc.
  • Lead threat modeling for increasingly complex attack surfaces, anticipating adversary behavior and translating it into concrete engineering requirements and defenses.
  • Shape the shared safety and security infrastructure that AI workloads depend on, ensuring defenses are reusable across products.

descriptionHtml:

Trust and Safety has the critical responsibility of protecting Google's users by ensuring online safety fighting fraud and abuse across Google products. We collaborate with anti-abuse teams across the company to identify and resolve the biggest problems that challenge the safety and integrity of our products. More specifically, in the Trust and Safety Chrome Web Store and Extensions Security team, we are responsible for protecting users from harmful extensions, while enabling developers to provide useful and safe experiences in Chrome.

As a Security and Applied AI Engineering Analyst, you will apply large-scale data analysis to protect Chrome users from abuse, discover and interpret attack vectors and leverage AI to build scaled protections to keep users safe. You will collaborate closely with Engineering and Product partners to identify threats, mitigate risks, and launch new protection mechanisms.

At Google we work hard to earn our users’ trust every day. Trust & Safety is Google’s team of abuse fighting and user trust experts working daily to make the internet a safer place. We partner with teams across Google to deliver bold solutions in abuse areas such as malware, spam and account hijacking. A team of Analysts, Policy Specialists, Engineers, and Program Managers, we work to reduce risk and fight abuse across all of Google’s products, protecting our users, advertisers, and publishers across the globe in over 40 languages.

Responsibilities

As a member of our LCS team, you'll have the unique opportunity to sell at the forefront of technology, collaborating with executives, influencing market-shaping strategies, and delivering tangible results that significantly impact major global businesses and drive the growth of Google.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $124000 - $180000 (USD) + 60% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Develop strategic partnerships to advance measurement maturity for customers by collaboratively establishing a clear road map for execution and translating complex concepts into clear stories for business stakeholders.
  • Evolve full funnel strategy by setting the required foundation and infrastructure for measurement needed to advance and maximize value. Consult on incrementality experiments, attribution and Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM).
  • Build trusted relationships with internal and external stakeholders, work with cross-site and cross-functional teams to drive short and long-term account growth, and partner with sales and product teams to identify data driven business growth opportunities.
  • Educate, drive influence, and build relationships with stakeholders through measurement subject matter knowledge.
  • Analyze large datasets and distill them into actionable insights that are presented in a logical and compelling story.

Minimum qualifications:

  • 8 years of experience in consulting, corporate strategy, technology sales, data analytics, performance marketing, business analysis, product strategy, or a related technical field.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience and a point of view on omni-channel (store/online/app) and Google products.
  • Strong project management and client-facing experience, delivering high-profile projects and influencing executive stakeholders while collaborating with cross-functional teams.

title: Physical Hardware Engineering Director
descriptionHtml:
As a Director of Physical Design Engineering, you will set the technical outlook and lead the execution for our next generation of rack to chip physical solutions, and associated toolings required for its physical operations. Operating at the highest levels of technical leadership, you will be the driving force behind the integration of complex robotics, mechanical and thermal management solutions to enable Google’s ASICs, TPUs, GPUs, CPUs, storage, and advanced networking hardware into our Data Center roadmap.

In this role, you will utilize experience developing highly innovative mechanical/thermal solutions for Computing hardware systems, while delivering them at high-velocity with high quality and reliability. You will lead the team on developing a compelling roadmap, mechanical/cooling solutions from chip to boards, boards to racks and racks to data center, anticipating fleet-level challenges before they happen and leading the industry in the ongoing AI hardware physical delivery and enclosure transformation including the use of Robotics automation systems. You will guide cross-functional teams, align external ecosystems and suppliers, and ensure our hardware scales reliably to meet the unrelenting demands of our global infrastructure. You will utilize direct deep technical expertise in physical design, significant management experience, experience delivery of complex projects and products, and ability to understand existing performance, quality, and advanced mechanical solutions manufacturing.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $275000 - $382000 (USD) + 30% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop a comprehensive physical hardware roadmap and solutions for Google’s data center hardware spanning ML TPU, GPU, Networking, Server compute, Storage, and any additional computing hardware and supporting solutions for data center.
  • Drive mechanical, cooling, and robotics solutions from early architecture through to volume production and data center deployment. Anticipate, troubleshoot, and mitigate complex, fleet-wide deployment challenges in a high-demand environment.
  • Steer technical engagements and partnerships with suppliers and ecosystem partners  to ensure high-quality, high-yield volume manufacturing.
  • Serve as the ultimate authority on system-level performance, heavily leveraging your deep expertise in managing complex trade-offs.
  • Elevate the engineering standards across the organization. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to senior engineers across hardware, silicon, and data center operations teams.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Product Design Engineering, Physics, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 15 years of experience working in the computing hardware industry.
  • 10 years of experience in technical leadership and engineering management.
  • Experience architecting and shipping hyperscale compute, telecom infrastructure, or high-reliability physical hardware products directly to the data center.

Preferred qualifications:

  • PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Product Design Engineering, Physics, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Knowledge in data center hardware physical development including mechanical design, thermal management, cables/interconnects, backplanes, robotics/automation, advanced packaging, manufacturing processes, and supply chain diversification.
  • Knowledge in mechanical and product design principles.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, resolve complex technical trade-offs, and drive consensus across large, globally distributed engineering organizations.

title: Senior Manager, Payments Finance
descriptionHtml:
The Payments Finance team provides strategic finance, planning, and analytics support across the Payments organization, spanning Payments Platform and Consumer Payments. We act as principal advisors to senior leadership, delivering strategic insights, commercial, and capital allocation frameworks that accelerate innovation and secure sustainable long-term growth across Google’s business generation ecosystem.

As a Finance Senior Manager, you will serve as the lead finance business partner supporting Payments Platform and Consumer Payments (ex-India). In this role, you will set the strategic financial agenda, steer multi-year business planning, and lead an FP&A team. You will drive enterprise-level decision-making across commercial structures, Agreement Desk evaluations, metric architecture, and cross-Product Area alignments.

The name Google came from "googol," a mathematical term for the number 1 followed by 100 zeros. And nobody at Google loves big numbers like the Finance team when providing in depth analysis on all manner of strategic decisions across Google products. From developing forward-thinking analysis to generating management reports to scaling our automated financial processes, the Finance organization is an important partner and advisor to the business.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Responsibilities

  • Steer end-to-end business planning, annual budgeting, target-setting, and rolling forecasts across Platform and Consumer divisions, balancing ambitious growth with operational discipline.
  • Oversee the Payments agreement desk and cross-product area (xPA) infrastructure initiatives, establishing commercial evaluation frameworks, pricing, margin expectations, and global transaction fee oversight.
  • Architect the input/output metric ecosystem and leading indicators to evaluate ecosystem health, transaction economics, platform efficiency, and user business generation.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Statistics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 14 years of experience in financial planning and analysis (FP&A), consulting, or a related function.

Preferred qualifications:

title: Research Engineer, Gemini Cyber Post-Training, DeepMind
descriptionHtml:
At Google, research-focused Software Engineers are embedded throughout the company, allowing them to setup large-scale tests and deploy promising ideas quickly and broadly. Ideas may come from internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes all over the world.

From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing new architectures, engineers work on real-world problems including artificial intelligence, data mining, natural language processing, hardware and software performance analysis, improving compilers for mobile platforms, as well as core search and much more. But you stay connected to your research roots as an active contributor to the wider research community by partnering with universities and publishing papers.

As a Research Engineer in the Cyber Gemini team, you will play a key role in both advancing our research capabilities and building the scalable infrastructure needed to support them. You will work on both the underlying cybersecurity models and custom orchestration harnesses, such as the skills and custom agent loops used for vulnerability verification. You will develop novel datasets and post-training recipes to enable Gemini to become more capable at vulnerability discovery, as well as evaluation datasets to measure the capabilities of our models.

As part of this role, you will also work closely with DeepMind's new Cyber Strike initiative, a high-profile, cross-organizational effort to build cybersecurity models to secure software and enterprise systems at scale. You will actively participate in the finding, fixing, and exploit tracks, curating datasets, building agentic evaluation benchmarks, and integrating CodeMender's vulnerability discovery and patching capabilities into the core Cyber Strike model.

Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.

We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $147000 - $210000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Build datasets (RL environments, SFT data) and iterate on post-training recipes. 
  • Debug and analyze RL training runs to identify potential bottlenecks and optimize training efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Build evaluation pipelines, benchmarks, and leaderboards to measure agent performance.

Minimum qualifications:

  • PhD degree in Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of experience (industry or academia) working in Reinforcement Learning environments.
  • Experience building distributed system infrastructure.
  • One or more publication records in vulnerability research (e.g. auditing, reverse engineering, exploitation).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with program analysis techniques (e.g., static analysis, symbolic execution, fuzzing).
  • Background in machine learning and statistics.
  • Independent, proactive attitude and a passion for the mission of AI safety and security.

title: Quản lý Khách hàng Chiến lược, Ứng dụng và Trò chơi, Khối Khách hàng chiến lược
descriptionHtml:
Doanh nghiệp thuộc mọi loại hình và quy mô tin tưởng vào các giải pháp quảng cáo vượt trội của Google để phát triển trong môi trường tiếp thị năng động hiện nay. Bạn mang trong mình niềm đam mê bán hàng, sự hiểu biết về truyền thông trực tuyến và lòng quyết tâm giúp khách hàng gặt hái được nhiều thành công nhất. Bạn hành động với tinh thần làm chủ, nhanh nhạy thích ứng với mọi thay đổi, tìm kiếm những cách thức mới mang tính chiến lược để liên tục đem đến kết quả ấn tượng và ngày một tốt hơn cho cả Google lẫn khách hàng. Bạn xây dựng mối quan hệ đáng tin cậy với khách hàng, tìm hiểu nhu cầu kinh doanh của họ và dựa vào đó để xây dựng các giải pháp hiệu quả giúp khách hàng đạt được những mục tiêu tham vọng nhất. Bạn gặt hái thành công cùng đội ngũ bán hàng, định hình tương lai của ngành quảng cáo trong kỷ nguyên AI và tạo dấu ấn thực sự đối với hàng triệu công ty cũng như hàng tỷ người dùng đặt trọn niềm tin vào Google cho những mục tiêu quan trọng nhất.

Với vai trò là Quản lý Khách hàng Chiến lược, bạn sẽ là một chuyên gia tiếp thị dựa trên hiệu suất, thúc đẩy sự tăng trưởng cho khách hàng thuộc lĩnh vực Ứng dụng và Trò chơi. Bạn sẽ đóng vai trò là một cố vấn tăng trưởng, tận dụng các giải pháp sử dụng AI của Google để mang lại kết quả kinh doanh và cải thiện dấu ấn trên toàn cầu của khách hàng. Bạn sẽ tập trung vào việc phát triển và cải thiện các chiến lược toàn phễu để đáp ứng các Chỉ báo hiệu suất chính (KPI) của khách hàng, chẳng hạn như Lợi tức trên chi tiêu quảng cáo (ROAS) và Giá trị vòng đời của khách hàng (LTV).

Bạn sẽ thúc đẩy sự xuất sắc bằng cách chinh phục khách hàng nhờ những giá trị độc đáo và tối đa hóa hiệu quả các giải pháp quảng cáo của chúng tôi. Bạn sẽ không ngừng chứng minh giá trị và làm nổi bật những thành công đã đạt được nhằm khơi dậy đà tăng trưởng trong tương lai cho khách hàng giữa kỷ nguyên AI đang không ngừng biến đổi.

Các nhóm thuộc Khối Khách hàng chiến lược (LCS) của Google là đối tác chiến lược và chuyên gia đầu ngành hỗ trợ các thương hiệu và công ty quảng cáo hàng đầu thế giới. Chúng tôi không ngừng khuyến khích khách hàng nhìn nhận lại hoạt động kinh doanh của họ và khám phá những cách Google có thể hỗ trợ họ tăng trưởng. Chúng tôi tập trung vào việc giúp các khách hàng này thích ứng với những thay đổi lớn trong ngành và thúc đẩy hiệu suất kinh doanh vượt trội bằng cách cung cấp trọn bộ giải pháp quảng cáo của Google ở mức giá cạnh tranh trên Google Tìm kiếm, YouTube, Đo lường, và nhiều nền tảng khác. Là một thành viên của khối LCS, bạn sẽ có cơ hội đặc biệt để kinh doanh những công nghệ tiên tiến nhất, làm việc với các quản lý cấp cao, tác động đến các chiến lược định hình thị trường và tạo ra kết quả thực tế, có ảnh hưởng đáng kể đến các doanh nghiệp lớn trên toàn cầu, cũng như thúc đẩy sự tăng trưởng của Google.

Responsibilities

  • Trở thành chuyên gia sản phẩm, hợp tác với các giám đốc sản phẩm tại các công ty thuộc ngành Trò chơi để điều chỉnh mức chi tiêu tiếp thị cho phù hợp với mục tiêu kinh doanh.
  • Quản lý hiệu suất chiến dịch và phân bổ ngân sách trên bộ sản phẩm quảng cáo của Google (Ứng dụng, Tìm kiếm, Hiển thị, Video), liên tục cải thiện mức chi tiêu để gia tăng Lợi tức đầu tư (ROI).
  • Tiến hành phân tích hiệu suất (ví dụ: phân bổ, thử nghiệm chiến lược, phân khúc đối tượng) để khám phá thông tin chi tiết và giải quyết các thách thức của khách hàng.
  • Phân tích các tập dữ liệu để xác định những điểm tắc nghẽn về hiệu suất, đồng thời đề xuất các chiến lược giá thầu và khung đo lường (ví dụ: SKAdNetwork, GA4).
  • Cung cấp thông tin và vận động sự ủng hộ cho Google khi trình bày các sản phẩm mới, hiệu suất và kết quả của chiến dịch cho khách hàng và công ty quảng cáo.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bằng cử nhân hoặc kinh nghiệm thực tế tương đương.
  • 2 năm kinh nghiệm tập trung vào tiếp thị dựa trên hiệu suất, tối ưu hoá truyền thông hoặc chiến lược tiếp thị dựa trên dữ liệu.
  • Khả năng giao tiếp thông thạo bằng cả tiếng Anh và tiếng Việt để giao tiếp với các bên liên quan nội bộ và hỗ trợ khách hàng nói tiếng Việt.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Kinh nghiệm sử dụng các công cụ phân tích (ví dụ: Google Analytics 4, mô hình phân bổ tiếp thị, trang tổng quan trực quan hoá dữ liệu và phần mềm bảng tính) cùng với kỹ năng giải quyết vấn đề xuất sắc.
  • Kiến thức về các sản phẩm quảng cáo của Google trên Ứng dụng, Video, Mạng Hiển thị và Tìm kiếm.
  • Hiểu biết về hệ sinh thái ứng dụng, bao gồm cả hoạt động tạo doanh thu và thu nạp người dùng dành riêng cho ngành Ứng dụng và trò chơi.
  • Khả năng gây ảnh hưởng đến các bên liên quan cả trong và ngoài tổ chức để đạt được mục tiêu.

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Generative AI, Search Intelligence
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.

The User-AI Flywheel team in Search Intelligence builds new AI-driven tools for automatic self-improvement, and feedback-driven model training and automated evaluations of all Google Search features and its ecosystem, including AI Mode and AI Overviews.

You will build products that impact billions of users while leading technical contributions in a team to make it happen. The role will benefit from a creative problem solver, focused on innovation, and willing to take calculated risks.

In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $262000 - $364000 (USD) + 25% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Advocate the development of modeling, tuning, and optimization techniques to support large language model (LLM) performance, quality, and capabilities.
  • Guide the design and implementation of user-signal-driven improvements of LLMs to address known loss patterns and response quality behaviors.
  • Partner with experts from Google Research and DeepMind to advance LLM technologies and integrate them into groundbreaking products.
  • Demonstrate exceptional teamwork, sharing your expertise in system design, machine learning modeling, and coding practices tailored to the LLM domain.
  • Cultivate relationships with stakeholders across the organization to collaboratively define and execute LLM initiatives.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in software development.
  • 7 years of experience leading technical project strategy, ML design, and optimizing industry-scale ML infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, data processing, debugging, fine tuning).
  • 5 years of experience with design and architecture; and testing/launching software products.
  • 2 years of experience with state of the art GenAI techniques (e.g., LLMs, Multi-Modal, Large Vision Models) or with GenAI-related concepts (language modeling, computer vision).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • 8 years of experience with data structures/algorithms.
  • 5 years of experience in a technical leadership role leading project teams and setting technical direction.
  • 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization involving cross-functional, or cross-business projects.

descriptionHtml:

In this role, you will tech-lead a team of AI/ML software engineers to grow the YouTube Shorts ecosystem by recommending Shorts that are aligned with users’ dynamically changing interests. The YouTube Shorts discovery models are a suite of large-scale AI/ML systems designed to model users’ interests by leveraging Google-wide data sources, understanding Shorts’ content and recommending the right content to the viewers. Designed for multi-task learning across various surfaces, these models are applied to numerous downstream tasks, including retrieval, user action predictions, rich user model generation, and knowledge distillation for training more compact models.

This role specializes in techniques—including LLMs, generative retrieval, and long-sequence modeling—to build foundational models for personalized retrieval and early-stage ranking.

The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

As a Platform Customer Engineer (CE), you will partner with technical Sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to our customers. You will serve as the customer’s primary technical partner and trusted advisor, engaging in technical-led conversations to understand their business issues. You will troubleshoot technical questions and roadblocks, engage in proofs-of-concepts and demos, and use your expertise to architect cross-pillar cloud solutions that solve these business issues. You will drive the technical win and define the delivery and consumption plans. You will use your presentation skills to engage with technical and business leaders, and persuasively present practical and useful solutions on Google Cloud. You will have excellent technical, communication and organizational skills.

You will focus on identifying, pursuing, and winning new business workloads and driving penetration testing within existing ones as a technical generalist. You will blend sales prowess, market knowledge and direct technical engagement.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and own the technical account plan and strategy, participating in planning and supporting specific sales motions.
  • Combine sales, programming, and solutions architecture to show the value of Google Cloud Platform across the portfolio through demos, pilots, and in-depth workshops.
  • Architect cross-pillar solutions, drive technical wins, and define initial delivery plans for customers; continue to lead the technical engagement in the solution phase.
  • Facilitate the post-sales transition by supporting pricing activities and transitioning the final delivery plan to implementation teams.
  • Maintain awareness of progress against the delivery plan, providing support to cross-functional teams during ramp, delivery, migration, or implementation phases.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer-facing or support role.
  • Experience with cloud engineering, on-premise engineering, virtualization, or containerization platforms.
  • Experience engaging with, and presenting to, technical stakeholders and executive leaders.
  • Experience in programming languages, debugging, systems design, prototyping, demos, or customer workshops.
  • Experience translating customer objectives into integrated cloud solutions across multiple domains.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience selling technical solutions in one or more of the following: infrastructure modernization, application modernization, data management, data analytics, Cloud AI, networking, migrations, security.
  • Experience managing the entire business cycle (e.g., defining the delivery and consumption plan and transitioning it for execution).
  • Experience building long-term technical strategies to uncover new workloads with customers.
  • Experience with security concepts (e.g., encryption, identity management, access control, attack vectors, or penetration testing).

title: Test Engineer, WiFi Test Lead
locations: New Taipei, Banqiao District, New Taipei City, Taiwan
descriptionHtml:
At Google, our philosophy is build it, break it and then rebuild it better. That thinking is at the core of how we approach testing at Google. Unlike roles with similar names at the other companies, Test Engineers at Google aren't manual testers -- you write scripts to automate testing and create tools so developers can test their own code. As a Test Engineer, you navigate Google's massive codebase, identify weak spots and constantly design better and creative ways to break software and identify potential problems. You'll have a huge impact on the quality of Google's growing suite of products and services.

As a part of the team, you will play a key role in delivering Pixel phones with exceptional Software/Hardware integrated quality. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams in multiple sites internationally, with a scope of End-to-End power and thermal testing. You will strive for quality and effective end-to-end automation testing as the team's scope is system testing across Pixel platforms with focus on power performance, power up and down the stack from apps, Android OS, multiple SW and subsystems features, modem and other connectivity modules that power the hardware.

The Google Pixel team focuses on designing and delivering the world's most helpful mobile experience. The team works on shaping the future of Pixel devices and services through some of the most advanced designs, techniques, products, and experiences in consumer electronics. This includes bringing together the best of Google’s artificial intelligence, software, and hardware to build global smartphones and create transformative experiences for users across the world.

Responsibilities

  • Plan, build, and execute end-to-end functional test cases covering IEEE 802.11 MAC/PHY protocol features, association/authentication state machines, WPA2/WPA3 security protocols, and 802.11k/v/r fast roaming.
  • Perform rigorous throughput, latency, rate-vs-range, rate-vs-orientation, coexistence/interoperability testing in both conductive and Over-The-Air RF environments, and design, build, and maintain automated test suites and frameworks using Python, integration with CI/CD pipelines, and automated test bed orchestration.
  • Utilize packet capture tools (Wireshark, Omnipeek) and RF protocol analyzers to debug frame-level issues, channel access bottlenecks, beamforming behavior, and connection drops.
  • Maintain and calibrate state-of-the-art wireless test setups, including RF attenuation chambers, shielded enclosures, programmable attenuators, channel emulators, and traffic generation tools (e.g., IxChariot, Spirent, OctoScope, Iperf).
  • Partner with firmware, software, hardware teams to isolate root causes, track defects, provide actionable debug logs, and verify bug fixes.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience in Wi-Fi functional and performance testing.
  • Experience with IEEE 802.11 standards (802.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be) and protocols, including MAC/PHY interaction, frame structures, MIMO/MU-MIMO, OFDMA, channel bonding, and mesh networking architectures.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 2 years of experience providing technical leadership and leading projects (e.g., test, release, etc.).
  • 1 year of experience working with executive leaders.
  • Experience with analytical and debugging skills with the ability to summarize complex technical findings clearly for engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Experience with packet sniffers (Wireshark, Omnipeek, Sanjole), wireless traffic generators (IxChariot, Spirent, OctoScope), and RF test equipment (spectrum analyzers, power meters).
  • Understanding of TCP/IP, UDP, DHCP, DNS, VLANs, IPv4/IPv6, and routing/switching concepts.

title: Engineering Manager, Google AI Compute
descriptionHtml:
Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started -- and as a manager, you guide the way.

With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally.

Google One (G1) is Google's membership for personal cloud storage and Google's cutting-edge AI features. G1 is one of Google's fastest growing subscriptions, with over 150 million subscribers. This is a unique opportunity to be part of a high-impact team, shaping the future of our subscriber experiences, premium features and business growth initiatives.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $207000 - $300000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and evolve the platform’s APIs and core runtime capabilities to support AI usage flows for products like Gemini and Antigravity.
  • Scale infrastructure to maintain availability, sub-millisecond validation latencies, and absolute transactional accuracy at extreme scale.
  • Lead, grow, and mentor a team of software engineers, fostering a collaborative and high-velocity engineering culture.
  • Define and enforce standards for code quality, testing, monitoring, and deep observability across all services on the critical path.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product, engineering, marketing, and data science teams to identify and prioritize growth opportunities.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in software development.
  • 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role.
  • 2 years of experience in a people management or team leadership role.
  • Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field.
  • 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization.
  • Experience with large-scale distributed systems and software architecture.
  • Experience with database systems such as Spanner.
  • Experience programming in Java and working with ML inference.

title: Research Engineer, Bioresilience, DeepMind
descriptionHtml:
At Google, research-focused Software Engineers are embedded throughout the company, allowing them to setup large-scale tests and deploy promising ideas quickly and broadly. Ideas may come from internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes all over the world.

From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing new architectures, engineers work on real-world problems including artificial intelligence, data mining, natural language processing, hardware and software performance analysis, improving compilers for mobile platforms, as well as core search and much more. But you stay connected to your research roots as an active contributor to the wider research community by partnering with universities and publishing papers.

As a part of the Research Engineer to join the Bioresilience Initiative (https://deepmind.google/blog/our-approach-to-bioresilience/) within the DeepMind Impact Accelerator team. In this role, you will build and deploy novel applications leveraging Google’s frontier AI and generative models.

As a part of the team, you will accelerate DeepMind’s societal impact on critical global challenges, collaborate with Biosecurity, GenAI, and Alphabet partners like Google Research, Cloud, and Isomorphic Labs, will develop solutions across biological threat prevention, early pathogen detection, and rapid response. You will translate cutting-edge AI breakthroughs into scalable tools that protect communities worldwide.

Your position requires domain expertise in life sciences, computational biology, or biosecurity alongside solid software engineering skills to prototype, benchmark, and scale products using state-of-the-art GenAI tools.

Join DeepMind to advance AI development, protect society from biological threats, and accelerate high-quality product innovation for public benefit.Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.

We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer varied learning opportunities and career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with product leadership, external authorities (biosecurity organizations, institutes, public health bodies), and cross-functional teams to navigate ambiguity, understand real-world biodefense challenges, and define technical architectures across Bioresilience workstreams.
  • Curate specialized biological datasets, design rigorous domain evaluations, and execute fine-tuning to maximize model performance on complex biological tasks.
  • Engineer 0-to-1 solutions and workflows using internal platforms, building sophisticated agents powered by foundation models such as Gemini, AlphaFold, and AlphaGenome.
  • Synthesize partner insights, edge cases, and deployment signals to inform future frontier model development and biological safety guardrails.
  • Advocate safe GenAI deployment best practices in bioresilience, demonstrating peak frontier model capabilities to solve critical biological problems end-to-end.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages.
  • 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience applying deep learning models to biological data (such as functional genomics or protein sequence data).
  • Experience manipulating common life science data types including FASTQ, SAM/BAM, gff, BED, VCF, and PDB/CI using bioinformatics or health informatics tools.
  • Demonstrated domain knowledge in life sciences, computational biology, or biosecurity (e.g., molecular biology, pathogen genomics, computational plant pathology, protein engineering, bioinformatics, or metagenomics).
  • Ability to identify, break down, and solve ambiguous and complex process and technical problems that span across many teams and organizations.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate biological concepts into computational workflows and evaluation benchmarks.

title: Senior SoC Power Engineer, Google Cloud
descriptionHtml:
Be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's direct-to-consumer products. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide. Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration.Our Platforms Infrastructure Engineering team designs and builds the hardware and software technologies that power all of Google's services. Our computational challenges are complex and unique, enabled by cutting-edge custom hardware designed and made in-house. As a hardware engineer, you will design and build the systems that are the heart of the world's largest and most powerful computing infrastructure. You will see those systems from concept all the way through to high-volume manufacturing. Your work has the potential to shape the machinery that goes into our cutting-edge data centers, affecting millions of Google users.

Responsibilities

  • Develop methodology of SoC roll up of power reduction, projection, configuration, test plan and tools.
  • Work intact with Architecture, Frontend and Backend teams driving power reduction features (both logic and circuit).
  • Work with power delivery and packaging teams on simulations and scenario definitions.
  • Work with Architecture and design verification (DV) to define power scenarios and tests, debug, and integrate into the flow. Track whether power goals are met throughout execution.
  • Lead the power of a project. Own project priorities, and allocation of technical resources within the project, informing and escalating appropriately when external factors impact execution.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in power estimation and optimization flows and tools.
  • Experience with vector based physical design power tools (e.g., PTPX prime power).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with power optimization techniques (multiple threshold voltage/power/voltage domain design, clock gating, power gating, dynamic voltage and frequency scaling (DVFS)/adaptive voltage scaling (AVS), etc.) and power management.
  • Experience with scripting languages (i.e., Python, Perl, TCL or Bash).
  • Experience in post silicon measurements, telemetry, correlation to pre-silicon.
  • Knowledge of the impact of software and architectural design decisions on power and thermal behavior of the system (thermal mitigation and scheduling, cross-layer policy design).
  • Knowledge of system software components (i.e., Linux, drivers, runtime performance analysis, etc.).
  • Knowledge of register-transfer level (RTL) micro-architecture and design for power.

title: Head of Semiconductor Manufacturing Planning and Fulfillment
locations: New Taipei, Banqiao District, New Taipei City, Taiwan
Zhubei, Zhubei City, Hsinchu County, Taiwan
descriptionHtml:
The Google Custom Silicon Operations team is responsible for all external manufacturing engagement and supplier management for the foundry and outsource manufacturing (OSAT) partners for building custom silicon for Google consumer hardware products. This includes foundry/OSAT sourcing, supplier management, end-to-end planning and procurement, and execution of development and manufacturing operations, with our suppliers in partnership with Google Engineering. It includes strategy development and orchestration with key stakeholders to shape the supply ecosystem for better partnership, capacity flexibility, high quality, business continuity, and cost effectiveness. It also includes on time delivery of ASIC (Application Specific Integrated Circuits) and other companion chips.


The Head of Semiconductor Manufacturing Planning and Fulfillment leads end-to-end supply chain operations for custom silicon and companion chips within Google’s hardware ecosystem. This role is responsible for establishing execution frameworks for supply and demand planning, managing supplier relationships, and ensuring material readiness from NPI through mass production. Key priorities include optimizing inventory visibility, logistics, and financial reconciliation, while driving fulfillment execution (PO management, production control). Additionally, you will report supply risks to executive stakeholders and build high-performing teams, fostering a culture of accountability and effective cross-functional collaboration. The ideal applicant will possess deep expertise in supply chain planning, semiconductor sub-component manufacturing processes or manufacturing operations management, coupled with strong problem-solving skills, and a proven track record in managing complex supply chains in a changing environment.

Responsibilities

  • Establish supply-demand execution frameworks and orchestration protocols for custom silicon, integrating signals from SOCs, memory, and manufacturing constraints to drive decision-making.
  • Orchestrate material readiness across global suppliers and internal stakeholders for new product introduction (NPI) and mass production, providing scenario plans and informed recommendations to achieve product launch milestones.
  • Optimize end-to-end inventory visibility and logistical flows from foundry to finished goods, partnering with Logistics, Finance, and Engineering to ensure regulatory compliance, complex yield reconciliation, and cycle-time efficiency.
  • Manage end-to-end fulfillment and production control—including POs, payments, and hot lot tracking—while reporting supply risks through dashboards; maintain data integrity and a single source of truth for all deliverables.
  • Cultivate a high-performing team by leading end-to-end talent management—from recruitment to mentorship—while fostering an accountable culture and resolving conflicts to ensure seamless supply operations.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 years of experience in program or project management.
  • 10 years of experience in semiconductor planning and fulfillment, and experience with mobile SoC development flows and manufacturing processes for Foundry, Die Prep, Assembly, and Test.
  • 7 years of experience in a leadership role.
  • Experience developing and deploying supply/demand planning and fulfillment systems, processes, and execution logistics, and leading initiatives in organizational development and cross-functional collaboration.

Preferred qualifications:

  • In-depth familiarity with Mobile SoC development flows and manufacturing processes for Foundry, Die Prep, Assembly, and Test.
  • Deep knowledge of foundry and OSAT suppliers and ecosystem with a specific focus on high-volume Mobile SoCs or complex consumer product applications.
  • Proven ability to unite teams toward common goals and resolve conflict in a matrixed global organization.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management skills with the ability to bridge the gap between technical engineering teams (Silicon/Hardware) and business operations.
  • Executive presence in managing suppliers, with excellent communication and presentation skills to key stakeholders and executive audience.

descriptionHtml:

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

Google Search is dedicated to organizing the world’s information and making it universally accessible and useful. Maintaining user trust requires protecting Search from increasingly sophisticated adversarial threats. The proliferation of Generative AI, automated synthetic content networks, LLM-driven parasite SEO, and agentic scraping has fundamentally transformed web spam from simple keyword manipulation into complex, automated adversarial campaigns.

As a Senior Product Manager for Google Search Anti-Spam and Abuse, you will define and drive the multi-year product strategy, technical architecture, and algorithmic defense mechanisms to combat AI-driven abuse at a global scale. You will partner closely with Research Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Regulatory and Policy Experts, Anti-Abuse experts, and Operations teams to ensure Search delivers high-quality, authentic information.

In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.

We encourage them to collaborate, think big and take risks in a blame-free environment. We promote self-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to create an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn and grow.

Google Home is in the midst of rapid product evolution and high momentum, driven by major software breakthroughs like Gemini for Home alongside a continuous pipeline of recent and upcoming hardware launches.

Our team operates at the unique intersection of physical hardware, distributed cloud infrastructure, and next-generation real-time Voice AI. We focus on high-leverage architectural engagements—partnering closely with development teams to simplify core backends, optimize ML serving, and ensure smart home interactions are instant, reliable, and trustworthy.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. title: Board Design Manager
descriptionHtml:
Be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's direct-to-consumer products. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide. Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration.

Google's mission is to organize the world's information and make it universally accessible and useful. As a Staff Board Design Engineer within the Silicon Systems and Engineering team, you will serve as the lead technical authority driving the architecture, schematic design, and complex layout of mission-critical printed circuit board platforms that power Google’s next-generation custom silicon—including Google Cloud Axion central processing units and Tensor Processing Units.

In this role, you will lead the end-to-end hardware development of advanced Reference Validation Platforms, silicon characterization boards, and high-density test fixtures.

You will manage bleeding-edge electrical, thermal, and mechanical tests—from designing high-current multi-phase power delivery networks to routing multi-gigabit high-speed serial links across ultra-high-layer-count substrates.

The ML, Systems, & Cloud AI (MSCA) organization at Google designs, implements, and manages the hardware, software, machine learning, and systems infrastructure for all Google services (Search, YouTube, etc.) and Google Cloud. Our end users are Googlers, Cloud customers and the billions of people who use Google services around the world.

We prioritize security, efficiency, and reliability across everything we do - from developing our latest TPUs to running a global network, while driving towards shaping the future of hyperscale computing. Our global impact spans software and hardware, including Google Cloud’s Vertex AI, the leading AI platform for bringing Gemini models to enterprise customers.

Responsibilities

  • Define system specifications, block diagrams, power trees, clock distribution topologies, and component selection for server-class silicon validation platforms and characterization fixtures.
  • Drive schematic capture and guided physical layout for high-density interconnect, ultra-high-layer-count (24+ layers) printed circuit boards utilizing advanced dielectric materials using Cadence Allegro, Concept, and OrCAD.
  • Partner with Signal Integrity and Power Integrity teams to implement decoupling strategies, multi-phase voltage regulator module designs capable of delivering high-current rails (>500 amperes to 1000+ amperes), and impedance-controlled high-speed routing.
  • Direct post-silicon board bring-up in the laboratory using high-speed oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and thermal imaging; mentored team members and established organization-wide hardware design guidelines.
  • Enforce strict Design for Manufacturing, Design for Assembly, and Design for Test guidelines; partnered with printed circuit board fabricators and electronics manufacturing service assembly houses to resolve technical issues and optimize yield.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
  • 10 years of experience in high-speed, multi-layer board-level hardware design.
  • 5 years of experience managing teams.
  • Experience designing and routing high-speed digital interfaces (e.g., PCIe Gen6, DDR5/LPDDR6, USB4, I3C, SPI, high-speed SerDes) and clock distribution networks.
  • Experience in schematic capture and PCB layout tools (specifically Cadence Allegro Design Authoring/Concept HDL and Allegro PCB Editor).
  • Experience designing multi-phase point-of-load (PoL) voltage regulators, high-efficiency DC-DC converters, power sequencing, and high-transient power delivery systems.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering with a focus on Hardware Systems, Power Electronics, or High-Speed Circuit Design.
  • 12 years of experience designing Reference Validation Platforms (RVPs), ATE characterization boards, or server motherboards for enterprise CPUs or AI/ML accelerators (TPUs/GPUs).
  • Experience designing ultra-high-current power delivery networks (>1000A) with advanced digital multi-phase PWM controllers (PMBus/AVS).
  • Experience leading multi-disciplinary engineering projects, driving ODM/EMS vendors, and mentoring junior/mid-level hardware engineers.
  • Deep knowledge of HDI, micro-vias, rigid-flex, low-loss laminate selection, and advanced manufacturing capabilities at PCB fabrication vendors.
